descriptionHtml:
缺陷 B27 · P2 · 新（部分已知）

失败状态提示不对或不清楚：Encounter 页 Generate 灰着但不说原因（已知 U59）；养老院 Save Note 被打断后提示说「文字被改过」；口述自动恢复后红色「断线」错误还挂着；快速口述转写失败时没有「⚠ 该怎么做」

票：TFA-94745 ready for qa · 算 QA bug：是 · 在哪发现：dev + 本地

同一个 bug的其他用例（只算一次）：EFS/S06, TC-10/S29, TC-23/S08

思路 / Approach · TC-04 Quick Dictation (Hospital only; TC-05 Rounding Sheet merged in) · S28 「云端语音转文字进框（transcribeAudio 被 mock）：'Transcribing…' 之后文字才逐字落下；429 时保住框并明说」 Cloud speech-to-text into a box (transcribeAudio mocked): text lands word for word only after 'Transcribing…'; a 429 keeps the box and says so

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U1 Quick Dictation opens from the Hospital home screen (patient list). The physician dictates or types into a box and adds a new box for the next patient, so one pad holds several boxes.（UAT TC-04；TFA-92582 step 1）
  • U2 Each box has 'Assign to patient', which opens a patient picker. Assigning appends the box's text verbatim to the end of that patient's encounter note and marks the box as assigned.（UAT TC-04；TFA-92582 AC 3；TFA-92582 steps 2-3）
  • U4 An unassigned box stays on the pad after Quick Dictation is closed and reopened, as the physician's own log. Boxes are never silently dropped. (The UAT says 'stays on the sheet'; …（UAT TC-04；TFA-92582 AC 5；TFA-92582 step 5；TFA-92583 AC 4）
  • U6 No auto-assignment anywhere: the app never splits one dictation across patients, never routes by name or room, and never merges boxes. There is no AI routing.（UAT TC-04；TFA-92582 AC 2；TFA-92583 AC 2）

测试设计方法：错误推测（error-guessing） — 专门去撞最容易出错的地方（失败、重复点、两个标签页、时钟不对、注入的指令）。

Given QA Hosp Patel (415); an account on the cloud engine (not ON_DEVICE_TEST_ENGINE); Chromium with a fake microphone; ai/transcribe:transcribeAudio answered through action-observer: first a held reply with the transcript below, then a rejection with a 429 'credit_balance_exhausted' error (as on dev, 2026-10-09)

When Dictate into an empty box, tap Stop, try Assign and Link while 'Transcribing…' shows, let the reply land, tap Link. Then dictate into a box that already holds 'Bed 415, stable.' and tap Stop while transcribeAudio rejects

Then Success: Assign and Link disabled while 'Transcribing…' shows; the box then holds the transcript word for word; after Link the chart holds it exactly. Failure: a visible '⚠' message; the box still holds 'Bed 415, stable.'; no 'Transcribing…' left and Assign to patient enabled within the capture ceiling (CAPTURE_CEILING_MS, 60 s); nothing reaches the chart

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：Playwright assertions: buttons disabled during 'Transcribing…' (U2: never placed half-heard); textarea toHaveValue(transcript) and encounterNotes toBe(transcript) (U2 verbatim, 3.4); on the 429, a message starting with '⚠' visible, textarea toHaveValue('Bed 415, stable.') (U4 never silently dropped), 'Assign to patient' enabled within 60 s (3.5 never left waiting with nothing) …

在哪跑：本地 newspec-b（新写的 Playwright）；测试方法 FAULT · 故障注入；矩阵里排的车道 现成测试（Tim 的 Playwright）（blocked）

S28 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-04.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

分诊（2026-10-14）：0 条。

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane newspec-b。

测试方法：FAULT · 故障注入（FAULT (transcribeAudio mocked: held reply, then 429)）；辅助：PW · Playwright 脚本 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：newspec-b。

UAT item: TC-04 Quick Dictation (Hospital only; TC-05 Rounding Sheet merged in) · Section: A1 · Home Screen & Dashboard · Scenario: TC-04/S28

Cloud speech-to-text into a box (transcribeAudio mocked): text lands word for word only after 'Transcribing…'; a 429 keeps the box and says so

Tickets: TFA-92582 Quick Dictation (ready for qa); TFA-92583 Rounding Sheet (ready for qa)

本地新 lane newspec-b：newspec-b/results.json 里 status failed → 失败·产品（失败·产品（lane 标了产品问题））。

怎么测（newspec-b/plan.json，automatable: yes）：Chromium with fake microphone flags (--use-fake-ui-for-media-stream, --use-fake-device-for-media-stream) on a fresh account switched to the cloud engine; whatever cloud path the pad uses is answered at the socket: ai/transcribe:transcribeAudio held then answered with the transcript, then rejected with a 429 credit_balance_exhausted error. Assert Assign/Link disabled while 'Transcribing…', verbatim text, encounterNotes after Link; on the 429 a visible message starting with '⚠' (the oracle's ^⚠, anywhere on the page; the error banner is recorded, not counted), the box keeps 'Bed 415, stable.', Assign enabled within 60 s, chart unchanged. — Built: the pad takes the batch path when prepareSession answers "batch" (answered at the socket), so transcribeAudio can be held and rejected; no audio leaves the machine.

Detail:

Re-run 17:02 with the oracle's '^⚠' assertion restored (no widened banner check). Success path passes: during 'Transcribing…' Assign is disabled and no Link is offered (box empty); the box then holds the transcript word for word and Link puts it on the chart exactly. On the 429: the box keeps 'Bed 415, stable.', no 'Transcribing…' left, Assign enabled 1.3 s after Stop, chart unchanged — all pass. Fails: no message starting with '⚠' anywhere on the page (warnLine null). The only notice is the app's global error banner, recorded: '[CONVEX A(ai/transcribe:transcribeAudio)] [Request ID: qa] Server Error Uncaught Error: 429 You exceeded your current quota (credit_balance_exhausted) Called by client'. Whether that banner may count as the oracle's message is a decision for Daniela, not a test edit.

产品问题：When cloud transcription fails (429 quota), the Quick Dictation pad shows no '⚠' line telling the physician what to do; the only notice is the app's error banner with the raw server string '[CONVEX A(ai/transcribe:transcribeAudio)] [Request ID: …] Server Error Uncaught Error: 429 … Called by client'. (The 429 wording comes from our mock, modelled on dev's 10-09 error, but the app prints err.message verbatim.) Cause on main: src/lib/speech/whisperSession.ts 'transcribe-failed' → report(err.message, true), then onInterim(''), so useQuickDictation.ts:287's '⚠' convention never fires. Breaks TC-04 S28 (U4/3.5 '⚠' message) and UAT Empty & Failure States: 'a clear message telling the physician what to do next' / transcription that still fails shows a clear message. The box text is kept (no data loss).

证据：附了 3 个。

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
